notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
Hello! 


Hope you are doing well both mentally and physically, we have some little news for you to tell. 

Based on your feedback, we released an update that:

[olist]
 Fixed the little typo errors that can be found in the system output messages, as well as in other parts of the game

Improved the written text (that starts before and after the day), so we hope that the game conveys its a message more clearly

Improved some of the dialogues in the game, to make them more convincing

Mike's blanket is now 2 times warmer!!!
[/olist]



Thanks for your patience. Your support and feedback means a lot to us



Sincerely,

SID team
